family.description: This entry represents the N-terminal transmembrane helices of the minor capsid protein P9 found in PBCV-1 and related viruses. These transmembrane helices are inserted in the bilayer membrane of the virus vesicle structure [[cite:PUB00154516]]. P9 plays a role in the stabilisation of the capsomers [[cite:PUB00154516]].
family.name: Minor capsid protein P9 transmembrane helices
